description: Implementation of DigitalProductService for managing digital products, including adding files, retrieving by product, deleting, and saving/updating digital products within an e-commerce system.

classes.name: DigitalProductServiceImpl
classes.description: Service implementation for managing digital products, including file handling and product status updates.

methods.name: addProductFile
methods.description: Adds a digital file to a product, updates product status, and manages file storage.

methods.name: getByProduct
methods.description: Retrieves a DigitalProduct by associated Product and MerchantStore.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Deletes a DigitalProduct, removes associated file, and updates product status.

methods.name: saveOrUpdate
methods.description: Saves or updates a DigitalProduct and marks the associated product as virtual.
